'''Xarth''' is a unique [[Tormented Demon|tormented demon]] boss that can be fought as part of [[The Fractured Archive]] raid. During a given raid, players can choose to fight Xarth or the [[Dagon'hai Elder]] and [[Dagon'hai Monk]]s as the fourth boss encounter.

Like most demons, Xarth has the [[Demon (attribute)|demon attribute]] and is susceptible to [[Demonbane weapons|demonbane]].

{{The Fractured Archive}}
